description: Fixed SigV4 signature mismatches (HTTP 403) on requests that send a header with more than one value, such as `Content-Encoding` with `gzip` and `aws-chunked`. The signer now trims each value and joins them with a bare comma, without quoting, which matches how services rebuild repeated headers before checking the signature. Fields with no values and trailer fields are no longer signed as headers. The `Field` interface also declares a bare comma as the default `as_string()` delimiter.
